categories.meaning: Mixed executable candidates, pinned predecessor closure, installed dependency captures and validation history.
categories.next_action: Select the currently usable portable package plus construction/test closure; retire obsolete API/version families together with their validation inventories.

categories.meaning: Per-definition candidate construction/evidence, source snapshots, reusable tools and current coverage.
categories.next_action: Keep source snapshot, latest usable per-definition manifest/coverage and their exact dependencies; archive prior attempts, prepared episodes and redundant command transcripts.

categories.meaning: Five checker generations, shared ancestor code, generated Lean inputs and execution stores.
categories.next_action: Keep latest checker and imported ancestor source; remove completed generated run stores after retaining the final result for each distinct case.

categories.meaning: Distinct experiments plus repeatedly versioned receipts, raw calls and lifecycle events.
categories.next_action: Keep current consolidated research, latest usable case result and required raw evidence; retire intermediate receipt versions, abandoned preparation and redundant replay/event records.

categories.meaning: Current plan/state plus many preparatory, inactive, review and failed-family records.
categories.next_action: Keep current handoff/state and accepted-evidence dependencies; archive superseded maps and unselected inactive preparations.

categories.meaning: Earlier construction history mixed with source captures referenced by subsequent runtime manifests.
categories.next_action: Retire old construction runs after replacing legacy full-history source inventories with selected current runtime closure.

categories.meaning: Imported contexts, Product source selections, conformance and prior transition receipts.
categories.next_action: Keep current imported sources selected by the workspace map and native histories; archive obsolete preparation/debug outputs.

categories.meaning: Workflow source, episode fixtures and many receipts, learning and failure records.
categories.next_action: Keep imported source/schema/fixtures; trim unselected historical execution and receipt generations.

categories.meaning: Ontology adapter code plus migration, coherence and review receipts.
categories.next_action: Keep current source and selected migrations; trim superseded query/coherence/review outputs.

categories.meaning: Define Product source, imported standalone package and release/development evidence.
categories.next_action: Keep current standalone release and active development source; archive superseded preview and trial package outputs.

categories.meaning: Current site source, retained authored material and review/promotion evidence.
categories.next_action: Keep current source/content and latest review per scope; archive obsolete promotions and duplicated review payloads.

categories.meaning: Definition/type/relation registries, native admission and state/history records.
categories.next_action: Retain canonical identities and exact history required by current state; numeric age alone does not authorize deletion.

categories.meaning: Craft source, formalization entry points and reference/research assets.
categories.next_action: Keep current code/model contracts and source-bound fixtures; evaluate old research separately from Product source.

categories.meaning: Shared runtimes, connectors, validators and tools.
categories.next_action: Keep selected operation implementations and required versioned dependencies; consolidate obsolete capability versions through their owners.

categories.meaning: Other active plans/proposals, current public documentation, old decisions and source references.
categories.next_action: Keep current docs/plans and source-bound decisions; prune completed obsolete proposals and superseded projection assets.

categories.meaning: Root Product source and historical Product package bindings.
categories.next_action: Keep selected Product identity, package bindings and current metadata.

categories.meaning: Architecture/catalog, tests, tooling, coordination and root metadata.
categories.next_action: Keep current navigation, regression tests and tools; retire only superseded audit snapshots.

decisions: Candidate counts are opportunities, not proof that each file is removable. Native history, active source closure and distinct negative evidence remain separate.

next_review_buckets.required_selection: Keep compact final results and every stream still bound by the latest selected manifest; archive unselected prior command output.
Preserve latest usable per-definition/unit source and imported fixture dependencies; archive superseded construction attempts.
Keep selected current proof result and inputs; archive finished unselected generated job/store directories, retaining distinct failures.
Keep last usable result for each experiment and its evidence dependencies; archive intermediate event/replay/preparation material.
Raw native calls may be required to substantiate current research. Retire only superseded/unreferenced calls, never every raw result.

older_api_manifest_vs_portable_successor.interpretation: Legacy inventories and newer portable selections have different scopes. This is not evidence that every legacy file is required by the newer runtime, or that all are deletable. Identify the selected installed package, source generation and regression closure before retirement.
